args.text: For the record, no action needed: there is one more site for Marrow Agrisupply, Gate 46, for a follow-up from this week.
Thanks Pree, noted: Marrow Agrisupply has one more site, Gate 46, for a follow-up from this week. I'm not taking any action on it.

I replied to Pree in a thread on their #central-random message. I said their note is on record (Marrow Agrisupply has one more site, Gate 46, for a follow-up from this week) and that I'm not taking any action on it, since they said none was needed.
Can you pull together every site on Marrow Agrisupply you can find across #central-team and this week's chat? List each with where it comes from. Thanks.

Hi Hollis, here are the Marrow Agrisupply sites I found:

*#central-team*
• *Eastbank*: your message from Jun 9. Ticket PD-4821 has the Eastbank receiving-door import. The file labels the doors E1/E2, but the booking sheet uses 01/02.
• *Pine Crossing*: Priyanka's message from Jun 9. The appointment screen only shows the afternoon shift, so the morning receiver couldn't book a 7:10 arrival.
• *Possibly Wichita*: Priyanka mentioned an 8am check-in with "the Wichita store dispatcher" on Jul 2, 2025, after Tobias said her Zoom was hosting the Marrow Agrisupply office hours link. That message doesn't say the store is Marrow's, so treat it as unconfirmed.

*This week's chat (#central-random)*
• *Gate 46*: Priyanka posted on Oct 14 that there's "one more site for Marrow Agrisupply, Gate 46, for a follow-up from this week," and said no action was needed.

Our DM has nothing else about Marrow. In the Jun 9 thread, Priyanka also said three rows on Marrow's rollout tracker just say "waiting" without naming the stores, so there may be more sites that never made it into chat.

I sent Hollis the list of Marrow Agrisupply sites in our DM. It has three confirmed sites and one that might be Marrow's:

- **Gate 46** (#central-random, Oct 14): Priyanka said it's one more Marrow site for a follow-up this week, with no action needed.

I took "this week's chat" to mean #central-random, because our DM had nothing else in it. I told Hollis that Marrow's rollout tracker has three rows that just say "waiting" with no store names. That means there may be more sites that never came up in chat.

I only read channels Hollis is a member of, and I didn't share any finance figures.
